summary: Retest of the single bug from iteration_26: removed the nuclear print CSS rule `body > *:not(:has(.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size])) { visibility: hidden }` from index.css. Re-ran full backend suite (same 3 pre-existing out-of-scope failures, unrelated) then re-ran all 5 relevant print-media browser checks by name only (no script resend). The previously-failing 'print-media-legacy-tag-preview-unaffected' now PASSES: .print-sheet on /tag/{id} is visibility:'visible' and readable under print media emulation. All 4 regression checks (A8 16-up, A7 8-up, A6 4-up tiling, AppShell chrome hidden) still pass unchanged. Bug from iteration_26 is confirmed fixed.
